    Frequently Asked Questions

    What is your hourly rate / project estimate process?

    For freelance development projects, I provide fixed-price proposals based on project scope or hourly billing for open-ended consulting ($45-$100/hr). For 1-on-1 tutoring, standard sessions start at $65/hr with package discounts.

    How are 1-on-1 tutoring sessions conducted?

    Sessions take place via Google Meet or Discord with screen sharing. We work directly inside VS Code and GitHub repositories so you get hands-on coding experience during every session.

    Can you help with emergency code reviews or debugging?

    Yes! If you have an urgent bug or deadline, mention it in your message and I'll endeavor to schedule an expedited consultation or asynchronous PR review within 24 hours.

    What timezone are you in and what is your availability?

    I operate in Central Time (UTC+5), but I regularly accommodate international clients and students across Europe, Asia, and the Americas.
